files.ideas/offline-maps.md:
---
title: Offline maps for the whole route
type: idea
status: exploring
tags: [maps, offline]
created: 2026-10-28
---
## Why

Half our interviewees lose signal on the trail (see [[user-interviews]]). If the map dies, the app is useless.

## What if

- Download a corridor 2 km around the planned route, not the whole region
- Use vector tiles so a 40 km route stays under 30 MB
- Decided format in [[0001-use-pmtiles-for-offline-maps]]

### Spark: What is the smallest version we could test this week?

Pre-download one popular trail and ship it to five beta hikers.

files.decisions/0001-use-pmtiles-for-offline-m:
---
title: Use PMTiles for offline maps
type: decision
status: accepted
tags: [maps, offline]
created: 2026-10-29
---
## Context

We need offline maps along a route ([[offline-maps]]) without running a tile server.

## Options

1. Raster MBTiles: simple, but 5x larger
2. PMTiles vector tiles: one static file, range requests, small
3. Mapbox offline packs: easy, but per-user cost and lock-in

## Decision

PMTiles, served as static files from object storage.

## Consequences

Need a style for vector rendering; no per-user cost; works with any CDN.
---
title: SQLite for on-device storage
type: decision
status: accepted
tags: [storage]
created: 2026-10-24
---
## Context

Routes, tracks and notes must work offline and sync later.

## Options

1. SQLite
2. A JSON file per route
3. IndexedDB only (web)

## Decision

SQLite on mobile, wrapped behind one storage interface.

## Consequences

Migrations need a version table from day one.
files.decisions/0003-no-accounts-in-v1.md:
---
title: No accounts in v1
type: decision
status: proposed
tags: [product, privacy]
created: 2026-11-04
---
## Context

Accounts add sign-up friction and a privacy burden. [[share-trip-link]] would need some identity.

## Options

1. No accounts; share links are random URLs
2. Email magic link
3. Sign in with Apple/Google

## Decision

Proposed: option 1 for v1. Revisit when sync ships.

## Consequences

No cross-device sync in v1.
files.notes/architecture.md:
---
title: Architecture overview
type: note
tags: [architecture]
created: 2026-10-20
---
# Architecture overview

- **App**: React Native, one codebase for iOS and Android
- **Maps**: vector tiles, see [[0001-use-pmtiles-for-offline-maps]]
- **Storage**: [[0002-sqlite-for-local-storage]]
- **Import**: GPX and FIT parsers in `src/import/`

```
app/ -> storage/ -> sqlite
     -> maps/    -> pmtiles (static files)
```
files.notes/user-interviews.md:
---
title: User interviews (October)
type: note
tags: [research]
created: 2026-10-18
---
Talked to 9 hikers.

- 5 of 9 lost signal on their last hike, and 3 of them turned back early because of it
- Everyone screenshots maps "just in case"
- 4 want to share their route with someone at home

Leads to [[offline-maps]] and [[share-trip-link]].
